title: The Teaching of the Wise

questions.question: A wise son hears his father's instruction, but a scoffer does not listen to what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:1 (ESV): "but a scoffer does not listen to rebuke."

questions.question: Whoever guards his mouth preserves his life; he who opens wide his lips comes to what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:3 (ESV): "he who opens wide his lips comes to ruin."

questions.question: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a desire fulfilled is a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:12 (ESV): "but a desire fulfilled is a tree of life."

questions.question: Whoever walks with the wise becomes wise, but the companion of fools will suffer what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:20 (ESV): "but the companion of fools will suffer harm."

questions.question: Whoever spares the rod hates his son, but he who loves him is diligent to do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:24 (ESV): "but he who loves him is diligent to discipline him."

questions.question: The soul of the sluggard craves and gets nothing, while the soul of the diligent is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:4 (ESV): "while the soul of the diligent is richly supplied."

questions.question: The light of the righteous rejoices, but the lamp of the wicked will be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:9 (ESV): "but the lamp of the wicked will be put out."

questions.question: Wealth gained hastily will dwindle, but whoever gathers little by little will do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:11 (ESV): "but whoever gathers little by little will increase it."

questions.question: Good sense wins favor, but the way of the treacherous is their what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:15 (ESV): "but the way of the treacherous is their ruin."

questions.question: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children's children, but the sinner's wealth is laid up for whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:22 (ESV): "but the sinner's wealth is laid up for the righteous."

questions.question: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, that one may turn away from the snares of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:14 (ESV): "that one may turn away from the snares of death."

questions.question: Every prudent man acts with knowledge, but a fool flaunts his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:16 (ESV): "but a fool flaunts his folly."

questions.question: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a faithful envoy brings what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:17 (ESV): "but a faithful envoy brings healing."

questions.question: Poverty and disgrace come to him who ignores instruction, but whoever heeds reproof is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:18 (ESV): "but whoever heeds reproof is honored."

questions.question: The fallow ground of the poor would yield much food, but it is swept away through what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 13:23 (ESV): "but it is swept away through injustice."

key_verse_text: Whoever walks with the wise becomes wise, but the companion of fools will suffer harm.
